description: Encoding-adaptive FileSystem backend and ctx.fsEncoding service: protects existing UTF-8 / UTF-8 BOM files while supporting explicit createText, callback > config > detection resolution, byte-exact edits for 16 legacy encodings, and encoding-aware grep.

sandbox.description: Confine mutations with sandboxPolicy (SandboxedFileSystem). Disable only when no sandbox policy is used.

encodings.description: Glob-to-encoding overrides (later rules win, supporting 'utf8' exemptions after broader rules, e.g. {"*.csv": "gbk", "legacy/**": "shift_jis", "legacy/README.txt": "utf8"}).

resolveEncoding.description: Optional custom encoding resolver callback (takes precedence over config.encodings and auto-detection).
